changelog_highlights.title: **Phase 0 — Locking of the 4 Irreversible v3.0 Arbitrations (`DECISIONS_V3.md`)*
changelog_highlights.summary: **Phase 0 — Locking of the 4 Irreversible v3.0 Arbitrations (`DECISIONS_V3.md`)**:

changelog_highlights.title: Option 1A (Strict Instrumental Controllability `Y` & Autonomous Activation Channel `A >= 0`)
changelog_highlights.summary: redefined `Y` strictly as perceived instrumental controllability, externalized physiological arousal / allostatic mobilization into an independent non-negative channel `A >= 0`, removed `computeActivation(p.y)` from `Cartograffect/AffectiveMatrix.lean`, refactored `isCoherentTerminalState` / `end_to_end_coherence` in `Cartograffect/AffectiveTaxonomy.lean`, and restored semantic symmetry on `Y-` (accommodation under objective action limits in `(X > 0, Y < 0)`; aversive low-control states relocated to `Y < 0` with elevated `A`).

changelog_highlights.title: Option 2a (Strict Stepwise Vertical Dynamics)
changelog_highlights.summary: unified vertical transitions under `ΔZ ∈ {-1, 0, +1}` with the sole downward short-circuit `2 → 0` bypassing `Surprise (Z = 1)`, removing direct multi-stratum jump projections from the manuscript, vector figures, Python engine, and `PredictiveEngineCanonical.lean`.

changelog_highlights.title: Option 3b (Charge/Discharge Symmetry Breaking for P2)
changelog_highlights.summary: restricted axial instability (`χ > 0`) exclusively to the two negative Charge poles (`Peur (-2,0,2)` and `Tristesse (0,-2,2)`), while positive Discharge poles (`Joie (0,2,2)` and `Courage (2,0,2)`) relax directly toward `Veille (0,0,0)` without spontaneous diagonal destabilization; removed `DepthTransitionKernel.antagonist_equivariant`.

changelog_highlights.title: Arbitration 4 (Publishable Scope `Z ∈ [0, 5]`, Canonical Discretization `Z ∈ {0, 1, 2}`)
changelog_highlights.summary: bounded the normative discretization to `Z ∈ {0, 1, 2}` (11 canonical positions: `Point de Veille`, `Surprise`, `Anticipation`, and the 8 primary crown prototypes) and `Z = 2` Rolls (2014) reward/punishment bijection (`Rew+`, `Rew−`, `Pun+`, `Pun−`, `rolls_contingencies_z2_bound`, `z2_rolls_bijection_2x2`), separating `Cartograffect/Lexicon176.lean` and `docs/02-Inventaire_176.md` (`Z = 0..7`) strictly as exploratory annexes outside the normative core.

changelog_highlights.summary: **Phase 1 — Probative Integrity Purges**:

changelog_highlights.title: Removal of Synthetic GRID-24 / CPM-142 Artifacts & Hardcoded Statistical Constants
changelog_highlights.summary: retired and archived `grid_cpm_integration.py`, `validate_grid_cartograffect_stats.py`, `build_full_cartograffect_dictionary.py`, `generate_publication_report.py`, and `SchererGRID.lean` (along with all hardcoded Python statistical scores certified by `decide`) into `archive/deprecated_synthetic_v2/`.

changelog_highlights.title: Sanitization of GEW 3.0 / Plutchik Exploratory Benchmark
changelog_highlights.summary: removed circular 2D refutation claims and hardcoded statistical scores from `extensions/lexicon/lean/EmotionWheelsChallenge.lean` (retaining 2 pure geometric invariants), removed hardcoded manual overrides in `extensions/lexicon/src/validate_emotion_wheels.py`, and reported hypotheses `H2` and `H4` strictly as non-corroborated without post-hoc reframing.

changelog_highlights.title: Quarantine of Synthetic DSM-5 / HiTOP Simulations & Requalification of In-Silico Exp 1
changelog_highlights.summary: isolated Experiments 4 and 5 (`04_dsm5_phenotyping.py`, `05_dsm5_full_nosology.py`, companion text) in `extensions/in_silico/exploratory_synthetic/` under explicit `SYNTHETIC EXPLORATORY ONLY — V3 = 0` banners, and requalified in-silico P1 as a numerical consistency check of the implemented budget projector `apply_budget_constraint`.

changelog_highlights.title: Exact Piecewise Antagonist Formula
changelog_highlights.summary: corrected the antagonist definition across code and documentation to `(-X, -Y, Z)` when `XY = 0` and `(-sgn(X)|Y|, -sgn(Y)|X|, Z)` when `XY ≠ 0`.
